job: Restore the last known-good real instanced wildflower field and a grass-only asymmetric fan atlas inside the proven progressive runtime, without restoring the synchronous million-instance meadow.

retainedKnownGoodRules: four-segment hero blades plus a much shorter one-segment filler layer
continuous clearance feathering around path, deck, stairs and props
density concentrated in the camera and house yard while the far field pays the budget
blade roots share the terrain palette and ground-darkening model
flowers share the meadow wind and remain one instanced draw
desktop, mobile and minimum flower populations are 1000, 380 and 200
flower drifts use the proven 0.13-frequency patch mask, 0.52-to-0.72 threshold, 8-to-24-metre yard weighting and 0.45 clearance gate
flower species remain clustered by coarse three-metre world cells and fade individually from 18 to 30 metres

required: six grass cells are deterministic shorter, broader asymmetric multi-fan clumps with irregular negative space
each grass cell has no more than two deliberately placed tall seed stems
subtle independently seeded longitudinal midribs remain inside existing leaf silhouettes and change RGB only
the exact proven 3600-position binary is retained and its 800 legacy flower slots are deterministically remapped to grass UV cells at decode time
the rendered offline atlas contains 3600 grass clumps and no billboard flower cards
the real geometry FlowerField from the known-good source is mounted as one bounded instanced draw with the proven patch, species, clearance, fade and shared-wind rules
the progressive worker, ACK pacing, schedule, page cap, governor and zero-idle demand loop remain unchanged
the atlas remains one alpha-masked draw; the restored real FlowerField is the only additional botanical draw and program
opening and corrected close texture coverage reach at least 98 percent against pinned baselines
full-run render p95, causal integration, interaction, camera convergence, flower pixels and settled demand remain green
fresh visual review confirms calm meadow mass, architectural hierarchy and no reed wall, confetti, barcode or wireframe effect

rejectionGates: baseline, ROI, classifier, threshold, proof, camera mapping, progressive schedule or page cap change
synchronous whole-field generation, runtime texture rasterization, or more than one real flower draw
the retained instance-table SHA changes or any billboard flower card remains in the rendered atlas
synchronized bands, repeated striping, wireframe, neon colour, rigid reed wall or home-obscuring overgrowth
any grass cell has more than two tall seed stems or loses asymmetric fan spacing
real instanced flower inventory differs from the proven 1000 desktop, 380 mobile and 200 minimum populations
opening or corrected close coverage is below 98 percent
hardware, performance, camera, interaction or zero-idle-demand gate fails
repairBoundary: If all runtime and non-visual gates pass, adjust either offline grass-card height by at most eight percent or real flower stem height by at most eight percent, never both. No count, patch distribution, schedule, proof, baseline or threshold changes.

failedEvidence.verdict: The restored visual and mobile plan pass, but desktop worker ACKs can overlap a 57 ms task. R03G cannot change its expressly retained ACK pacing, so it is rejected without weakening any threshold.
failedEvidence.freshReview: block: pacing change requires an explicit successor rather than an undocumented R03G exception
